errors.description: mux_status_q is a multi-bit value produced in scan_clk and sampled directly in func_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
scan_done_pulse_q is a one-cycle scan_clk pulse consumed directly in func_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
scan_done_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample func_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in func_event_o.
select_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector select_q before decoding in func_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
scan_rst_n is used as data inside func_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines scan_clk payload state with func_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
